history.reason: First budget: 25 KB gzip is about half a second on a 400 kbps 3G link, and the offline copy may be about one and a half times that because it also holds the icons.
The install logic has to be there on the first visit, because the browser can offer to install at any moment, and the offline copy now holds the full icon set.
The report form and the outbox: an installer can file a report on the very first visit, so they cannot be loaded later. They cost 10.7 KB gzip.

No change to the two totals. Added a limit for any single file, so one file cannot quietly grow into a monolith (js/views.js is the largest, at 8.4 KB gzip), and moved all limits into this file so the script, the tests and the README read the same numbers.
